observed_process: Self in --self-observation; SCM-reported PID held by limited query reference in future M1, not authenticated runtime
process_handles: GetProcessHandleCount on observed process reference; not administrative aggregate
collector_handles: Current collector process count; alias self mode is not counted as another actor
working_set_bytes: Observed process current working set, not exclusive unique system RAM ownership
system_commit_available_bytes: (CommitLimit - CommitTotal) * PageSize, current global available commit; no reservation or growth guarantee
handle_query_ticks: QPC interval of process handle query including counter instrumentation overhead
memory_query_ticks: QPC interval of observed-process memory query including counter overhead
system_query_ticks: Final query bucket: GetPerformanceInfo plus collector self counters when another process is observed; NOT isolated SCM/kernel/provider cost
qpc_collection_begin_end: Entire sample including pre/post status/process continuity checks; multiple API observations are not an atomic global snapshot
preparation_qpc_ticks: Future M1 only: SCM/status/process query-reference acquisition; no value demonstrated by self mode
freshness: Intervals are observational evidence; no SCQ max age, TTL or validity policy granted
closed_refs: Only handles created by metadata observer; never a service/SCQ/global quiescence proof
native_SCM: NOT_EXECUTED_THIS_TASK; model logs explicitly identify modeled scope
